283823353.description:
Collection of 14 rough mineral specimens primarily composed of feldspar with visible inclusions of black tourmaline (schorl) and quartz. The stones range in color from off-white to beige, some exhibiting orange-brown staining. They have a coarse, crystalline texture with jagged edges and raw, unpolished surfaces. Black tourmaline appears as thin veins or small patches within the feldspar matrix, alongside quartz inclusions. Specimens vary in size and shape, preserved in natural condition. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects.

Dimensions: For size reference, the largest size is 2.5 x 1.5 inches

Geode, Crystal & Mineral Specimen Collection Lot
Natural & Polished Geological Specimens
Multi-Piece Assortment, 9.4 lbs Total Weight
A diverse collection of lapidary and geological specimens featuring natural geodes, polished bookend halves, druzy quartz plates, and mineral formations. The assortment highlights varied crystallization habits, quartz interiors, banded chalcedony agate rings, and crystalline clusters suitable for study, display, or lapidary crafting.
Includes 2 cut and polished display geode halves (one dyed blue agate, one natural grey banded agate)
Multiple hollow quartz geodes with sparkling internal crystal druse
Several druzy crystalline quartz plates and mineral clusters
Metallic mineral cluster and bagged assortment of small crystal fragments and stones
Combined specimen weight: approximately 9.4 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimens with rough matrix exteriors and naturally fractured surfaces. Polished faces on the two cut agate bookends are smooth with flat bases for freestanding tabletop display. Minor natural shedding of small crystal debris is typical of raw mineral geodes.

Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The specimens exhibit natural geological features, including internal fractures and surface textures inherent to natural minerals. The tumbled stones have a smooth, high-polish finish. The quartz cluster shows minor contact marks and natural inclusions typical of geological specimens.
